prompt: Create an original 60 second deep instrumental house instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: warm synth chords, four-on-floor drums, sub bass. Style: consistent dance groove, small filter movement, no large drop. Tempo approximately 134 BPM; C major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: An energetic and driving electronic dance track featuring a prominent synth melody, pulsating bassline, and a steady, upbeat drum beat. It builds with layers of synths and a consistent rhythm.
description.zh: 一首充满活力和动感的电子舞曲，具有突出的合成器旋律、脉动的低音线和稳定、欢快的鼓点。它通过合成器层和一致的节奏进行构建。
